+	hashPolicyTypeQueryParameter
+	hashPolicyTypeFilterState
+	hashPolicyTypeSourceIP
+)
+
+// hashPolicyEntry is a single hash policy along with the key used to identify it for deduplication.
+type hashPolicyEntry struct {
+	typ    hashPolicyType
+	key    string
+	policy *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+func (e hashPolicyEntry) id() string {
+	return strconv.Itoa(int(e.typ)) + "/" + e.key
+}
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	// disable suppresses all hash policies on the route
+	disable bool
+	// entries are the hash policies in canonical type order, deduplicated by type and key.
+	// If empty (and not disabled), a default sourceIp hash policy is used.
+	entries []hashPolicyEntry
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	o, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil || o == nil {
+		return c == nil && o == nil
+	}
+	if c.disable != o.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.entries, o.entries, func(a, b hashPolicyEntry) bool {
+		return a.typ == b.typ && a.key == b.key && proto.Equal(a.policy, b.policy)
+	})
+}
+
+// Validate performs PGV validation on the hash policies.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, e := range c.entries {
+		if rw := e.policy.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite(); rw != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(rw.GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash header regexRewrite pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+		if err := e.policy.Validate(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// hashPolicies returns the Envoy hash policies to set on the route.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) hashPolicies() []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if len(c.entries) == 0 {
+		// default to hashing on the source IP when no hash policies are specified
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{sourceIPHashPolicyEntry(false).policy}
+	}
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(c.entries))
+	for _, e := range c.entries {
+		out = append(out, e.policy)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+// constructConsistentHash constructs the consistent hash policy IR from the policy specification.
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if ptr.Deref(ch.Disable, false) {
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var entries []hashPolicyEntry
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			hp.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, hashPolicyEntry{
+			typ: hashPolicyTypeHeader,
+			// HTTP header names are case-insensitive
+			key: strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName),
+			policy: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{Header: hp},
+				Terminal:        ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		cp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+			Path: ptr.Deref(c.Path, ""),
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil {
+			ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash cookie %q ttl: %w", c.Name, err)
+			}
+			cp.Ttl = durationpb.New(ttl)
+		}
+		for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+			cp.Attributes = append(cp.Attributes, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+				Name:  attr.Name,
+				Value: ptr.Deref(attr.Value, ""),
+			})
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, hashPolicyEntry{
+			typ: hashPolicyTypeCookie,
+			key: c.Name,
+			policy: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{Cookie: cp},
+				Terminal:        ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		entries = append(entries, hashPolicyEntry{
+			typ: hashPolicyTypeQueryParameter,
+			key: q.Name,
+			policy: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+					QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+						Name: q.Name,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(q.Terminal, false),
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+		entries = append(entries, hashPolicyEntry{
+			typ: hashPolicyTypeFilterState,
+			key: f.Key,
+			policy: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+					FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+						Key: f.Key,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(f.Terminal, false),
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		entries = append(entries, sourceIPHashPolicyEntry(ptr.Deref(ch.SourceIP.Terminal, false)))
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		entries: dedupHashPolicyEntries(entries),
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sourceIPHashPolicyEntry(terminal bool) hashPolicyEntry {
+	return hashPolicyEntry{
+		typ: hashPolicyTypeSourceIP,
+		policy: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: terminal,
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+// parseCookieTTL parses a cookie TTL given either as a Go duration (e.g. "1h30m")
+// or as an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600").
+func parseCookieTTL(s string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}
+
+// dedupHashPolicyEntries removes entries with a duplicate type and key, keeping the first
+// occurrence, and stably sorts the result into canonical type order.
+func dedupHashPolicyEntries(entries []hashPolicyEntry) []hashPolicyEntry {
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(entries))
+	out := make([]hashPolicyEntry, 0, len(entries))
+	for _, e := range entries {
+		id := e.id()
+		if _, ok := seen[id]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[id] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, e)
+	}
+	slices.SortStableFunc(out, func(a, b hashPolicyEntry) int {
+		return int(a.typ) - int(b.typ)
+	})
+	return out
+}
+
+// mergeConsistentHashIR unions the hash policies of hi (higher priority) and lo (lower priority).
+// Entries from hi take precedence over entries from lo with the same key, and the sourceIp
+// hash policy is always taken from hi. The result is a new IR; the inputs are never modified.
+func mergeConsistentHashIR(hi, lo *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	entries := make([]hashPolicyEntry, 0, len(hi.entries)+len(lo.entries))
+	entries = append(entries, hi.entries...)
+	for _, e := range lo.entries {
+		if e.typ == hashPolicyTypeSourceIP {
+			continue
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, e)
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		entries: dedupHashPolicyEntries(entries),
+	}
+}
+
+// applyConsistentHash applies the consistent hash policy to the Envoy route action.
+func applyConsistentHash(ch *consistentHashIR, action *envoyroutev3.RouteAction) {
+	if ch == nil || action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = ch.hashPolicies()
+}
